one_liner: Cloud phone system for sales and support teams.
access_notes: Requires an Aircall customer account for API keys (private app); OAuth is limited to approved Technology Partners, who get a 4-month trial developer account. Direct Messaging API needs the Professional plan.
mcp_note: Aircall MCP (read-only calls/conversation data), https://support.aircall.io/en-gb/articles/39677926959517; note developer.aircall.io mcp-faqs page still says no MCP server offered (likely stale)
blocker_note: No free tier shown; Messaging API not on all plans; OAuth needs partner approval.
